title.en: Test systems of the source texts as small witnesses
title.zh: 来源二篇之检验系统之小见证

statement.en: Small witnesses in the grammar show decay and overlapping identities, two of the source texts' test systems, and narrower stand-ins: a line of descent, two family lines and a belief whose rate grows with its number, each with what the grammar tells apart in it.
statement.zh: 来源二篇之检验系统中之衰变与无清楚之界，及较窄之代者（传承之线、二家族之线、传播之率随其数而增之信念），于文法中皆有小见证，各示文法于其中所分。

laws.en: Decay: in a net where no occurrence reaches itself, the decay is an alteration under the one; in the net of possibilities, both stay and decay open at every intact moment, "intact or not" is constant and every two intact moments are alike in its core; a history within that net, decaying at its second step, has its two intact moments apart in that core.
laws.zh: 衰变：无事自及之网中，衰变为一之下之异；可能之网中，每一完之时刻皆可完可变，「完与否」有常，任二完之时刻于其核中同；此网内一史于第二步衰变，其二完之时刻于此核中分。

laws.en: No clear boundary: two overlapping identities, each a class; an occurrence ends under one and begins under the other; their union is not a class, and its line from the first occurrence reaches the third with its ends apart.
laws.zh: 无清楚之界：二相交之同一，各为类；一事于其一下终而于其二下生；二者之并非类，其线自首事及于第三事而两端分。

laws.en: A line of descent generates at two grains: on the endless line of descent, the line under the one never ends and ahead of every point a member begins.
laws.zh: 传承之线于两种粒度生成：无尽之传承之线上，一下之续不尽，每一点之前皆有一成员始生。

laws.en: Two family lines: the class of one family line lies strictly between a member's class and the one, is constant, and its core goes on through each birth while the member's line ends; from one family's first birth no member of the other family is reached, even under the one.
laws.zh: 二家族之线：一家之线之类严在成员之类与一之间，有常，其核于每一出生处续而成员之线终；自一家之首次出生，即于一之下，亦不及他家之任何成员。

laws.en: A belief whose rate of spread grows with its number: on the step one holder at rate 0 goes to one holder at rate 1, and one holder at rates 0 and 1 lie apart in the core of same number.
laws.zh: 传播之率随其数而增之信念：一步之中，一持者率零至一持者率一；一持者于率零与率一，于「同数」之核中分。

hypotheses.en: No axiom; each net is supplied with the behaviour in question (decay possible at every intact moment; every occurrence of descent with a successor); discrete steps and equality on the carriers; for the belief, natural-number counts and the linear laws held + rate and rate + held, read through the adaptive process of Becoming.Mechanism.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理；各网连同所问之行为给出（每一完之时刻皆可变；传承之每一事皆有后继）；离散之步与载体上之相等；信念设自然数之计与线性之律 held + rate、rate + held，经 Becoming.Mechanism 之自适之变而读。

does_not_show.en: That any actual nucleus, lineage or belief is so, or which net an actual decay is.
does_not_show.zh: 实有之核、传承或信念如此，或实有之衰变是何网。

does_not_show.en: Probabilities of decay, a vortex, a graded boundary, or an institution's identity through replaced people, rules and purposes.
does_not_show.zh: 衰变之概率、涡、渐变之界，或机构经人、规与目的之替换而存之同一。

does_not_show.en: Self-maintenance and adaptive regulation, or an organism that ends: the line of descent cannot end.
does_not_show.zh: 自持与自适之调节，或有终之生体：传承之线不能终。

does_not_show.en: A belief system whose content or law of spread changes: the laws here are supplied and fixed.
does_not_show.zh: 其内容或传播之律有变之信念体系：此处之律为所给而定。

validation_scope.en: Machine-checked by the consolidated Lean 4.29.1 checker (receipt 20261023T221345.406636Z): Becoming.GrammarCases, 22 theorems in 37 declarations, every declaration with an empty axiom report; the checker verifies core purity. Author review in study section 393.
validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器实查（回执 20261023T221345.406636Z）：Becoming.GrammarCases，37 项声明中 22 条定理，公理报告皆空；检查器并核对核心纯净。作者审查见研究第 393 节。

next_delta.en: A vortex; an institution's identity through replaced parts; an organism that renews its parts and ends; a model read off actual data for one system; decay with its probabilities in the periphery.
next_delta.zh: 涡；机构经部分之替换而存之同一；更新其部分而有终之生体；读自实有之数据之某一系统之模型；外围中带概率之衰变。

correspondence.en: The test systems of the first source text (§7): decay and the system with no clear boundary as stated; the organism and the belief system by narrower stand-ins; the second text's pair of observationally equivalent institutions is the thermostat witness read socially, not restated.
correspondence.zh: 第一篇来源之检验系统（§7）：衰变与无清楚之界如所述；生体与信念体系以较窄之代者；第二篇之二观察等价之机构，是以社会读之恒温之见证，未重述。

detail.zh: 恒温之见证；以同意或以惩罚而持之机构是其社会之读。
